witnesses.separates: The odd object is two dominoes that touch at a corner. Under 8-adjacency it is one object of a shape no other object has, and it turns 2; under 4-adjacency it is two dominoes of one shape, and they turn 1.

The odd object is a 3x3 block less a corner, beside two 3x3 rings: it has their cell count and their bbox. By shape it turns 2; by cell count or by bbox extent no object is unique, and all turn 1; as the fewest cells or the smallest bbox, all three tie and turn 2.
The odd object is a 3x3 ring, larger than the two 2x2 blocks. By shape, cell count or bbox extent the ring turns 2; as the fewest cells or the smallest bbox, the blocks turn 2 and the ring 1.
The odd object is the copies' L shape turned a quarter. By shape up to translation it turns 2; up to D4, or by cell count, all three match and turn 1.

Three 2x2 blocks and two 1x3 bars: every shape has a copy. By a unique shape all turn 1; outside the commonest shape, the bars turn 2; with the copy class of exactly two members, the bars turn 1 and the blocks 2.

8 covers 70 cells and 0 covers 30. The stored object color 8 recolors the bars and the block; the rarest color is 0, so the 0 cells are the objects, both of a unique shape, and turn 2 while the 8 cells stay.

8 covers 70 cells and 0 covers 30. The stored background 0 leaves the 8 cells as the objects; the dominant color is 8, so the 0 cells are the objects, both of a unique shape, and turn 2 while the 8 cells stay.

A single 3 cell stands apart from the three 8 objects. As object-color cells, the 3 cell is no object and stays 3; as non-background cells, it is an object of a unique shape and turns 2; with the rarest color as the object color, it alone is the object and turns 2 while every 8 stays.

One cell of a copy is 3. As object-color cells, that copy loses a cell and every object is unique, so all turn 2 and the 3 stays; as non-background cells, the two rings match and turn 1, the 3 with them; with colors in the shape, the rings differ and all turn 2.
Three 2x2 blocks and one 1x3 bar. By a unique shape the blocks turn 1 and the bar 2; with the copy class of exactly two members, no class has two, and all turn 2.
